content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Vacancy 2026 - 247 Posts
content_sections.text: WBPSC has announced 247 Industrial Development Officer vacancies . The detailed notification reports the following reserved and special-category allocations.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Industrial Development Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a degree from a recognized university OR a Diploma in Engineering or Technology from a recognized university or institution . The notification does not restrict degree eligibility to engineering graduates only. Yes. The official qualification states that candidates with a degree from a recognized university are eligible. It does not require every applicant to hold an engineering degree. Applicants must also satisfy the age, Bengali language and other recruitment conditions. Yes. Candidates holding a recognized Diploma in Engineering or Technology are eligible under the alternative qualification route. A Bachelor's degree is not mandatory for candidates who meet the prescribed diploma requirement. Yes. Candidates must be able to read, write and speak Bengali. However, the notification provides an exemption for candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali, unless specifically mentioned otherwise. Bengali language ability will be tested during the interview. Candidates performing poorly in the language test may have their candidature cancelled. WBPSC IDO Syllabus 2026

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Industrial Development Officers will receive pay under Level 10 of the West Bengal Services (Revision of Pay and Allowance) Rules, 2019 , with a pay scale of Rs. 32,100 to Rs. 82,900 . Salary Clarification: Rs. 32,100 is the starting basic pay, not the complete in-hand monthly salary. Other admissible allowances and applicable deductions depend on Government rules.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 160 plus applicable service charges . Eligible SC/ST candidates of West Bengal and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities having at least 40% disability are exempt. Payment Mode: Online only. Fee Payment Last Date: 26 November 2026 at 3:00 PM. The application fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred to another examination.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection consists of a 100-mark written examination and a 15-mark interview . The final merit list will be prepared using the combined marks obtained in both stages, out of 115. The commission may fix category-wise cut-off marks in the written examination for shortlisting candidates for interview. There are no separate minimum qualifying marks for the interview.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination will consist of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying one mark each , with a duration of 1 hour 30 minutes . Yes. The written examination carries a penalty of 0.25 marks for every incorrect multiple-choice answer. These percentages apply to the aggregate marks from the written examination and interview. They are minimum qualifying standards, not guaranteed selection cut-offs. The commission may further relax qualifying marks if a substantial number of reserved posts remain unfilled. If two or more candidates receive the same aggregate marks, the older candidate will receive preference based on date of birth while preparing the recommendation.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications for 247 Industrial Development Officer posts from 6 November to 26 November 2026. Official Application Website: WBPSC Online Recruitment Portal 15/2024. Application Last Date: 26 November 2026 at 3:00 PM. Edit Window: 27 November to 2 December 2026, up to 3:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official West Bengal Public Service Commission website at psc.wb.gov.in . Open the online application or candidate login section. Find . Register or log in using your existing account, as applicable. Read the complete recruitment instructions. Enter the required personal and contact information. Fill in the educational qualification details. Provide the relevant age, category and reservation information. Enter one accepted photo identity document, its number and issuing authority. Complete the applicable declarations. Review all entered details carefully. Pay Rs. 160 plus applicable service charges if not exempted. Submit the application by 26 November 2026 at 3:00 PM . Save and print the application form for future reference. Access the edit window between 27 November and 2 December 2026 if required. Upload the requisite documents during the prescribed edit-window period. Verify the final submitted details and keep the acknowledgement. Important: Submission of more than one application by the same candidate is strictly prohibited and may lead to cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Application Edit Window 2026
content_sections.text: WBPSC will provide a facility to edit certain application fields from 27 November to 2 December 2026, up to 3:00 PM . Applicants seeking an address change must first update their address in the Profile section and then use the Edit option. No modification requests will be entertained after the edit window closes.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready, as applicable, for completing the application, edit-window requirements and subsequent verification. Degree certificate or Engineering/Technology Diploma. Relevant marksheets. Madhyamik or equivalent certificate for date-of-birth verification. Valid photo identity document. SC/ST/OBC-NCL certificate, where applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate, where applicable. PwBD disability certificate, where applicable. Prescribed scribe-related medical certificate, where required. Meritorious Sportsperson certificate and applicable prescribed form. Official marks conversion formula, if the qualification uses grades. Any additional document required by WBPSC. Applicants claiming category or reservation benefits must possess the relevant certificates by the application closing date. OBC-NCL and EWS candidates must also furnish renewed or revalidated certificates before interview and at appointment, as prescribed.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Reservation and Certificate Rules
content_sections.text: SC, ST, OBC and EWS reservation benefits are governed by West Bengal Government rules and are generally available to eligible candidates belonging to the respective categories in West Bengal. Yes. Candidates from other states may apply if they meet the eligibility requirements. However, SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates from other states must apply as General candidates for the applicable unreserved vacancies, subject to the notification. OBC-NCL applicants claiming West Bengal reservation must possess the prescribed certificate from the competent authority and submit a renewed or revalidated certificate before interview and appointment. EWS candidates must possess a valid Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format. Renewal or revalidation is required at the later stages specified by the commission. Eligible candidates with benchmark disabilities and writing limitations may receive a scribe facility under the prescribed conditions. Where applicable, candidates must submit the required medical certificate in the format specified in Appendix-I. The notification provides 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour for eligible candidates with the required disability-related writing limitation and certification. Requests for engagement of a scribe must satisfy the conditions specified during application submission.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Written Exam and Interview Dates 2026
content_sections.text: WBPSC will publish examination schedules, admit card information, model answers and subsequent recruitment notices through psc.wb.gov.in . Candidates must carry their valid admit card and the same photo identification document specified in the application to the examination venue.

faq.question: Q1. When will the WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: The online application process for WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026 will start on 06 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in WBPSC IDO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: WBPSC has announced 247 Industrial Development Officer vacancies under the Directorate of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises.

faq.question: Q4. Why is the advertisement number 15/2024 for recruitment in 2026?
faq.answer: The indicative advertisement was issued on 24 December 2024 under Advertisement No. 15/2024. The detailed recruitment process and online application period are scheduled for 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for WBPSC Industrial Development Officer?

faq.question: Q6. Can non-engineering graduates apply for WBPSC IDO?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification accepts a degree from a recognized university without limiting the degree route to engineering qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. Can diploma holders apply for WBPSC IDO Recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with a recognized Diploma in Engineering or Technology are eligible, subject to other conditions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the WBPSC IDO age limit?
faq.answer: The prescribed age limit is 18 to 44 years as on 1 January 2024, with applicable relaxation.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary of a WBPSC Industrial Development Officer?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 32,100 to Rs. 82,900 under Level 10, with admissible allowances.
